old_description: Are you a Curbside Laundries customer? Click here to see Branding Made Easy with Howie Flagler!
about:
Spector Textile Products operates from a 50,000-square-foot facility in Lawrence, Massachusetts. The company has served industrial accounts across North America for more than 85 years and remains a family-owned and operated business. Established as a family enterprise, it has grown into a primary source for manufactured textile products.

The company specializes in custom manufacturing of textile products, including industrial-grade truck covers, laundry bags, and paper products for offices and construction trailers. Its diverse product line serves both small and large companies, with an emphasis on short-run and custom orders. Custom printing of logos on laundromat products is a core service. Production and inventory are managed from its 50,000-square-foot Lawrence facility, enabling immediate delivery on many items.

Spector supplies paint and hardware stores, construction firms, laundry and dry-cleaning businesses, medical facilities, industrial uniform providers, and moving-supply companies throughout North America.

The company emphasizes a personal-touch approach, with employees guiding customers from concept to finished product, and highlights that its goods are made in the USA.

name: Spectrum Plastics Group, A DuPont Business
old_description: Tucson specializes in design, development & manufacturing of highly-engineered catheters as well as silicone extrusions, molded components and assemblies.
about:
Spectrum Plastics Group, a DuPont business, operates its flagship packaging manufacturing facility in Pleasant Prairie, Wisconsin. The 161,000-square-foot site runs 35 extrusion lines around the clock and holds an ISO Class 7 cleanroom. The company traces its roots to PPC Industries, Inc., doing business as Spectrum Plastics Group, and became part of DuPont's portfolio.

The facility specializes in blown film extrusion, producing commodity and specialty poly bags, converted pouches, and monolayer and coextruded films. Beyond film, the company offers microbore and silicone extrusion, injection molding, precision machining, laser processing, and finishing services including assembly and sub-assembly manufacturing. Capabilities extend to concept development, quick-turn prototyping, regulatory support, and manufacturing transfer programs.

Spectrum serves medical device OEMs across cardiovascular, structural heart, neurovascular, electrophysiology, orthopedics, robotic surgery, fluid management, gastrointestinal, pharmaceutical, urology, ophthalmology, trauma care, and diagnostics markets. It also supplies industrial and defense sectors, food packaging, and drug delivery device manufacturers. The component webstore provides off-the-shelf tubing and components for rapid procurement.

The company emphasizes its six-sigma-level extrusion of acetal core mandrels, on-site same-day testing and revision, and a full-service model that spans design through scalable production. Its quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 13485:2016, and ISO FSSC 22000, with CE marking for European market access.

name: Speed Systems Inc
old_description: Experienced, Knowledgeable Team in the Electrical Utility Industry
about:
Speed Systems Inc was founded in 1970 in Brookfield, Wisconsin. The company operates a manufacturing facility in Brookfield where it designs and builds tools for the electrical utility industry. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces hand- and drill-operated tools, adjustable tools that eliminate the need for bushings, and specialized equipment for preparing primary and secondary cable for termination and for installing cable system components. It also offers custom tool design, developing wrenches and other tools based on direct input from linemen. All products are manufactured at the Brookfield facility.

Speed Systems serves the electrical utility sector, selling through authorized distributors in the United States, Canada, and internationally. Manufacturer representatives are located across the U.S. to support local needs. End users include linemen and utility contractors who use the tools for power cable installation and maintenance.

The company emphasizes safety, efficiency, ergonomics, and value in its designs. It highlights fast lead times and a responsive custom-tool process as key differentiators, with the goal of meeting specific field requirements.

name: Split Mountain Metals
old_description: Welcome to Split Mountain Metals! We specialize in custom metal art, signs, parts and now even more! Come to us for all of your metal art needs!
about:
Split Mountain Metals was founded in 2014 by Brad and Carley Brenteson in Belgrade, Montana. Brad Brenteson brought a lifetime of metalworking experience, from growing up on a farm in north-central Montana to formal training as a machinist and welder in Helena. The couple established the shop to provide architectural steel fabrication for high-end residential projects across the state.

The company produces custom steel stairs, railings and guards, fireplace surrounds and cladding, exposed structural steel such as trusses and knife plates, steel-fin screens and gates, and chimney caps in raw steel, Corten, or stainless. Every project begins with a detailed consultation and design approval before any material is cut; all layout, cutting, welding, and finishing is performed in the Belgrade facility.

Split Mountain Metals works directly with architects, interior designers, and high-end residential builders who require precision fabrication for exceptional homes. Their work appears in projects throughout Montana, including floating stairs, horizontal-bar railings, blackened-steel fireplace surrounds, and exposed steel trusses for luxury residences.

The founders emphasize a “Montana made, built to last” philosophy, standing behind every piece with a commitment to correct any issue. The shop’s differentiator is a collaborative process that ensures the fabricator represents the architect’s vision exactly, with nothing cut until the client approves the design.

name: St. Cousair, Inc.
old_description: We use cookies to give you the best experience on our website.
about:
St. Cousair, Inc. operates a 26,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art production facility in Newberg, Oregon, situated in the Willamette Valley with convenient access to local ingredients and national distribution networks. The company has accumulated over 40 years of product development and production experience for retail and food-service channels.

The firm provides end-to-end co-packing services for a broad range of shelf-stable and refrigerated foods and beverages, including jams, jellies, preserves, chutneys, compotes, soups, nut butters, dips, dressings, oils, pasta sauces, smoothies, vinegar drinks, and fruit juices. Production runs are handled in glass jars and bottles for retail and in plastic containers for food service, supported by an in-house R&D lab, quality-control systems, and labeling-compliance expertise. The facility can accommodate volumes of any size, from prototype batches to large-scale runs, with a staff of approximately 800.

St. Cousair serves regional, national, and international food markets, working with both emerging brands and established companies. A noted client is BG Reynolds Syrups, whose president cited the company's capacity, systems, and growth support as key factors in their partnership. The customer base spans retail grocery, food-service distributors, and private-label programs.

The company emphasizes its "Crafted with Passion" philosophy, combining local ingredient sourcing, innovative recipe development, and rigorous quality control to differentiate its co-packing offering. Founders and ownership details are not publicly disclosed, but the business positions its technical capability, flexible volumes, and regulatory support as core reasons clients choose them.

name: Standard Electric Supply Co.
old_description: Get SAME-DAY SHIPPING on In Stock orders placed by 2pm CST M-F
about:
Standard Electric Supply Co. is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, and has operated as a family-owned electrical distributor since its founding in 1919. Now in its fourth generation of family leadership, the company began as a local supplier and has grown into a regional partner for industrial automation and control products.

The company maintains 16 stocking locations across Wisconsin, Illinois, and Indiana, holding over $45 million in inventory to support same-day shipping on orders placed by 2 p.m. CST. Its distribution portfolio spans automation components, batteries, hardware, conduit, enclosures, fuses, industrial controls, lighting, motors, drives, sensors, safety equipment, tools, wire, and cable. Beyond product supply, Standard Electric provides 24/7 engineering support, inventory management, enclosure modification, repair services, kitting and custom assemblies, national customer solutions, IIoT integration, a 24-hour support line, and training seminars. The company reports an on-time delivery rate exceeding 99 percent.

Standard Electric serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) environments across industrial sectors. Its customers include facilities that rely on automation and control systems to keep production running, from discrete manufacturing plants to process industries. The company's services are tailored to reduce downtime and manage inventory risk for operations teams facing lean staffing and high reliability demands.

President Larry Stern emphasizes a "tradition of innovation and service" built on continuous improvement, aiming to reduce complexity for customers through fewer handoffs, clearer communication, and accountability for outcomes rather than just orders. The firm's long-term partnership model focuses on adapting support to each facility's unique constraints, whether through engineering expertise, inventory programs, or technical training.

name: Stars Design Group
old_description: From design to production and logistics to delivery, our integrated team of experts here in the U.S., and overseas offices, are dedicated to managing every step of the apparel manufacturing process.
about:
Stars Design Group is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. The company traces its origins to 1993 when Stars Apparel International, Inc. was founded in Turkey in response to retail and wholesale demand for high-quality, ethically responsible garments. In 2000, the group established its U.S. headquarters to centralize design, merchandising, and manufacturing oversight for its global operations.

The firm operates as a full-package apparel manufacturer, handling design, production, and delivery. Its U.S. design teams use 3D simulation software and a rotating library of fabrics and trims to develop collections. Manufacturing is coordinated through a network of 67 hand-selected factories across 14 countries, with third-party inspection teams conducting inline and post-production quality checks. regions.

Stars serves lifestyle apparel brands ranging from established corporations to start-up labels and small retailers. Its client base spans the retail, wholesale, and housewares sectors, with an emphasis on brands seeking to maintain exclusive equity while expanding globally.

The company was created to fill a gap for ethically responsible manufacturing and differentiates itself through a strict code of conduct, long-standing factory relationships, and digital tools that accelerate design approval and reduce errors.
